title: HomeFlood Re-Rate Credit — Date the Credit Runs From
content:
**Rule.** Under HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies, the re-rate credit for a certificate review is counted in days from a start date to the term end, over the days from the term start to the term end. The start date turns on when Tidemark received the certificate, counted in calendar days from the term start.

| Receipt of the certificate | The re-rate credit runs from |
|---|---|
| before the term start, or no more than 30 days after it | the term start, because a certificate submitted with the term rates the whole term |
| more than 30 days after the term start, with a survey date after the term start | the certificate's survey date, because the certificate then documents mitigation completed during the term |
| more than 30 days after the term start, with a survey date on or before the term start | the date Tidemark received the certificate |

**Records read.** The certificate under review is the most recently received Elevation Certificate entry on the policy; where several share the latest receipt date, the one recorded first counts. It is read for its receipt date and its survey date.

## Boundary cases (term starting 1 January)

| Received | Survey date | Runs from |
|---|---|---|
| 20 December of the year before | 2 December of the year before | 1 January |
| 31 January (30 days after the start) | 10 January | 1 January |
| 1 February (31 days after the start) | 10 January | 10 January |
| 20 June | 15 April | 15 April |
| 20 June | 1 January | 20 June (the survey date is not after the term start) |
